findings.explanation: CH-U001-001 attributes the supported Like-button claim to a named 2014 Stanford trial and named researcher. The supplied source evidence supports the Like-button claim and mechanism but provides no support for that trial, date, institution, or researcher; those specifics also exceed the concept-only sufficiency licensed by PLAN-U001.

assessments.rationale: CH-U001-001 presents the attribution as an established source fact. SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 directly supports the sentence about the Facebook Like button, while SRC-U001-ANCHOR-001 and SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001 support its explanatory mechanism. None supports the named trial, year, institution, or researcher. PLAN-U001 requires no special framing and permits mechanistic explanation, so framing and underlying claim strength fit, but the unsupported named attribution makes the target only partially supported.
